text: ROBI’s performance over the last week was solid, with 58 orders successfully delivered and an average robot time of 98 seconds. The most frequent cause of failure was ‘unknown’ status, occurring 57 times, notably on orders [cite:2] and [cite:3]. Several orders, including [cite:7] (water bottle, 817s) and many others with a ‘search_exhausted’ status [cite:N], took significantly longer than average. **It would be beneficial to investigate the ‘unknown’ failure reason more closely, potentially focusing on areas where the ‘[[detection]]’ system might be struggling.**
